title: Ask
say: Pick a preset (a transaction or an MCP tool call) or type your own parameters, and send them. Mock is the default, so this needs no tenant and no network.

title: Decide
say: The engine answers with a verdict, the statements and obligations behind it, and how long it took. The Mock engine says it is Mock on every call.

title: Read the call
say: Open the call to see the exact request and the raw response next to the readable verdict. A permit with an obligation shows as step-up or consent, and INDETERMINATE is never shown as a permit.

title: Go live, on purpose
say: Switch to Live only when you mean to: set up a PingOne environment or an on-prem PingAuthorize on the Settings page. The app may then reach only the PingOne hosts for your region, or the PingAuthorize URL you typed, and nothing else.
